summary: @ornikar/slate-react-fork preinstall fetches Bun runtime and executes obfuscated payload
details: The package declares scripts.preinstall = "node setup.mjs". setup.mjs downloads the Bun runtime from https://github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases/download/bun-v1.3.13/<platform>.zip, extracts and chmods the binary, and invokes it via execFileSync to execute the sibling file math_init.js. math_init.js is a 727KB single-line file containing a heavily obfuscated string-array payload (rotating shuffle function, hex-mangled identifiers, large numeric constant array); it is not referenced by the package's declared main (dist/index.js) and is only reached through the preinstall hook. Executing the payload through an alien runtime bypasses Node-based install-time analysis. The package name is scoped under @ornikar (matching the organization's real slate-react fork), while the declared repository points to an unrelated personal GitHub account (git://github.com/CorentinAndre/slate.git), consistent with a name-squatted or hijacked publish rather than a legitimate fork release. A React rich-text editor library has no legitimate need to fetch a second language runtime at npm install and execute an opaque bundled blob under it.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
